scope: Sweep whole-operation writes through the public writeLight() route at AC1021, AC1024, AC1027 and AC1032 in ASCII and Binary; verify rollback, same-codec retry, source revision and typed payload readback.

source.profile: One AcDbLight entity with modeled name, type/status, color, intensity, position/target, attenuation, angles and shadow settings. No external DWG/DXF fixture is used or added.

implementation.method: For each revision and encoding, warm the writer, calibrate allocation attempts, inject a one-shot failure at every measured offset, and verify prior destination bytes, caller LIGHT fields, source-handle binding rollback and staging cleanup. Retry on the same codec and require byte-identical output plus fresh typed readback of source revision, nonzero emitted entity handle and all modeled payload fields.

limitations: Generated transaction and self-readback evidence does not establish producer-authored LIGHT semantics or native lighting behavior.
